messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: make src/test/unit-distribution using g++ when CC=clang++
parts:
Has anyone else seen this on develop? I do

make clean-all > /dev/null && make CC=clang++ -j8 src/test/unit* > /tmp/clang++.log && echo "success"

and it mostly uses clang++. But sometimes it decides to revert to g++ and as a result chokes the RAM

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] make src/test/unit-distribution using g++ when CC=clang++
parts:
I've seen this behaviour from time to time with make on a variety of projects where it somehow spontaneously ignores the values of certain variables.  I honestly have no idea why or how this happens but you're not alone.  One of the stranger mysteries of make.

Cheers,
Marcus
